data.long_description:
Presenting an exclusive, one-of-a-kind residence in the iconic D1 Tower, Al Jaddaf, meticulously upgraded to the highest standards. This exceptional home blends sophisticated design with outstanding functionality, making it ideal for discerning end-users or investors seeking strong rental returns.

The apartment features a generous open-plan living and dining area, enhanced by floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the space with natural light while offering stunning urban and creekside views. The custom-designed kitchen is fitted with premium cabinetry, upgraded countertops, and integrated appliances—perfect for both everyday living and entertaining.

The residence includes four modern bathrooms, all finished with high-quality fittings and contemporary detailing, providing comfort, convenience, and privacy.

Property Highlights:

Exclusive listing
Fully upgraded throughout
4 modern bathrooms
High-quality finishes and fittings
Bright interiors with floor-to-ceiling windows
Premium tower with hotel-style amenities

D1 Tower Amenities:

Swimming pool
State-of-the-art gym
24/7 concierge and security
Valet service and covered parking
Access to luxury hotel facilities

Ideally located in Al Jaddaf, just minutes from Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, Dubai Creek, and Dubai Healthcare City, this residence offers exceptional connectivity and a refined waterfront lifestyle.

Company Name: Provident Real Estate
RERA ORN: 1933
